
	<h1 class="postTitle"><a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/lixingqiu/p/19576562" title="发布于 2026-02-04 21:49">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">约瑟夫问题模拟算法可视化程序_C++精灵库算法可视化程序</span>
    

</a>
</h1>
	<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><span><img alt="约瑟夫问题模拟算法可视化程" width="193" height="201" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/523461/202602/523461-20260204214655999-1625860307.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p>先看视频更好理解，约瑟夫问题模拟算法可视化程序_C++精灵库算法可视化程序(抖音C++精灵库官方账号)：</p>
<p>&nbsp;<a href="https://www.douyin.com/video/7602999293472984355" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://www.douyin.com/video/7602999293472984355</a></p>
<p>场景设定：在肖申克监狱的院子里，一群囚犯围成一个圈，正在进行一个奇特的“游戏”。安迪（Andy）和瑞德（Red）站在一旁，观察着这一切。</p>
<p><span>瑞德（Red）：嘿，安迪，你看那边那群家伙在搞什么名堂啊？</span></p>
<p><span>安迪（Andy）：哦，瑞德，这是他们在玩“约瑟夫游戏”。每次报数到3的人就得“出局”，就像是一种残酷的淘汰赛。</span></p>
<p><span>瑞德（Red）：听起来挺有意思的。那他们是怎么开始的？</span></p>
<p><span>安迪（Andy）：你看，他们从0号开始，每个人按顺序报数。1，2，3——报到3的那位兄弟就得“阵亡”了。</span></p>
<p><span>瑞德（Red）：（笑）“阵亡”？这词用得真贴切。那第一个“阵亡”的是谁？</span></p>
<p><span>安迪（Andy）：（指着屏幕）看，是2号。他刚报完“3”，就“阵亡”了。现在轮到5号接着报数。</span></p>
<p><span>瑞德（Red）：（点头）嗯，5号接着报“1”，然后8号报“2”，1号报“3”——他又“阵亡”了。</span></p>
<p><span>安迪（Andy）：没错，就这样一轮一轮地淘汰。每次“阵亡”的人都会变成半透明，就像魂魄出窍一样。</span></p>
<p><span>瑞德（Red）：（大笑）魂魄出窍！这话说得我都有点毛骨悚然了。那现在轮到谁了？</span></p>
<p><span>安迪（Andy）：现在是6号报“3”，他也“阵亡”了。游戏继续，直到所有人都“阵亡”。</span></p>
<p><span>瑞德（Red）：（惊叹）哇，这游戏真是既刺激又残酷。那最后的“阵亡”顺序是怎样的？</span></p>
<p><span>安迪（Andy）：（指着屏幕上的序列）你看，最终的“阵亡”顺序是：2、5、8、1、6、0、7、4、9、3。每个人按照这个顺序一一“阵亡”。</span></p>
<p><span>瑞德（Red）：（感叹）真是精妙的设计。这游戏不仅考验智力，还考验心理承受能力。</span></p>
<p><span>安迪（Andy）：（微笑）是啊，瑞德。在这肖申克的院子里，我们总能找到各种方式来打发时间，甚至在“阵亡”中找到乐趣。</span></p>
<p><span>瑞德（Red）：（大笑）安迪，你总是能用最乐观的心态来看待一切。来，我们再去看看他们怎么玩下一个轮次吧！</span></p>
<p><span>旁白：在肖申克的高墙之内，这群囚犯用“约瑟夫游戏”找到了一丝丝生活的乐趣。而安迪和瑞德，也在这游戏中，找到了彼此间的默契与友谊。这就是肖申克的故事，一个关于希望与自由的故事。</span></p>
<p><span>程序所有代码如下：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 约瑟夫问题模拟算法可视化程序，本程序需C++精灵库V1.0.3。
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 下面拟有10个人，报到3的出队，索引从0开始，从它开始报数。</span>
#include <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">sprites.h</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">包含C++精灵库 </span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">namespace</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> std;
Screen screen;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> main(){        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">主功能块 </span>
   screen.bgcolor(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">black</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);   
   </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">bubble0.png是红色的圆圈，上面有0，这些圆圈是用另一个程序生成的，如果没有，请自行生成
   </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">bubble1.png是橙色的圆圈，上面有1，其它依次类推，圆形颜色的色相相隔36。</span>
   vector&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>&gt;shapes = {<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">res/bubble0.png</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">res/bubble1.png</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">res/bubble2.png</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">res/bubble3.png</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">res/bubble4.png</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">res/bubble5.png</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">res/bubble6.png</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">res/bubble7.png</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">res/bubble8.png</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">res/bubble9.png</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">};
   vector</span>&lt;Sprite*&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> persons;
   </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span>(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> i=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>;i&lt;<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10</span>;i++){   <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">生成10个角色，用不同颜色的圆圈代替</span>
       Sprite* j = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Sprite(shapes[i]);
       j</span>-&gt;setheading(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">360</span>-i*<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">36</span>+<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">90</span>);  j-&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">penup();
       j</span>-&gt;fd(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">160</span>);j-&gt;setflag(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">alive</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>);j-&gt;seth(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
       persons.push_back(j);
   }   
   Sprite bao{</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">blank</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>};                 <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">在最上面写报数的数字的1,2,3的</span>
   bao.penup().sety(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">330</span>).color(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">red</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
   Sprite pen{</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">blank</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>};                 <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">无造型的角色，用于报告谁出队了</span>
   pen.penup().sety(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">250</span>).color(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">magenta</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
   
   </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">新建箭头造型的角色ptr</span>
   Sprite ptr{<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">res/pointer_blue.png</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>}; <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">在中间的蓝色的指示器，谁报到3了，就会出队，先把角色变成透明效果来表示</span>
   ptr.seth(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">90</span>);                      <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">初始方向指向0号角色（红色的上面写0的圆圈)</span>
   <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">bool</span> diedflag[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10</span>]={<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span>};      <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">描述是否出队的布尔数组</span>
   <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> baoshu= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>;   <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">报数器</span>
   <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> cntdied = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>;  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">统计出队的人数</span>
   vector&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>&gt; seq;        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">保存出队顺序</span>
   <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">while</span>(cntdied&lt;<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">){
       </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span>(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> i=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>;i&lt;<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10</span>;i++<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">){          
          </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>(diedflag[i]==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span>)<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">continue</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">此人已死，下一个</span>
          baoshu++<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;            
          ptr.setheading(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">360</span>-i*<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">36</span>+<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">90</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
          bao.cleartxts(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>).write(to_string(baoshu),<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">40</span>); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">最上面显示1,2,3</span>
          delay(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
          </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>(baoshu==<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">){          
             seq.push_back(i);
             persons[i]</span>-&gt;setalpha(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">50</span>);  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">透明，表示已死</span>
             <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> s = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">编号</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> + to_string(i) +<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">已死</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
             pen.cleartxts(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>).write(s,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">33</span>).wait(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
             diedflag[i]</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span>; baoshu=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>;  cntdied++; <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">死亡人数增加1</span>
             pen.cleartxts(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
          }
       }
   }
   bao.cleartxts(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>).write(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">出队序列</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">40</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
   </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">最终出队顺序是2 5 8 1 6 0 7 4 9 3  ，下面可视化的显示这个序列 </span>
   <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span>(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> i=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>;i&lt;<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10</span>;i++<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">){
      persons[seq[i]]</span>-&gt;stamp();   <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">在原位置盖图章</span>
      persons[seq[i]]-&gt;setalpha(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">255</span>);        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">恢复alpha通道为255</span>
      persons[seq[i]]-&gt;go(-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">200</span> + i*<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">50</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">250</span>);  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">定位到上面去排成一行，从而可视化显示出队序列</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">   } 
   screen.done();     </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">完成了</span>
   <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>;    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">返回0</span>
}</pre>
